org.eclipse.dirigible:dirigible-components-core-java 14.15.0 发布, Lightweight runtime primitives shared between components/engine/engine-java (the full
        client-Java engine — synchronizer, compiler, ClassConsumer SPI, controller routing) and
        components/engine/engine-bpm-flowable (only needs to resolve client-compiled classes from
        delegate expressions). Extracted from engine-java's runtime package so engine-bpm-flowable
        can depend on this small leaf module instead of the full engine — that in turn lets
        components/api/api-modules-java publish the org.eclipse.dirigible.sdk.* annotations to
        engine-java without forming a cycle through api-bpm.

items.title:
org.eclipse.dirigible:dirigible-components-core-liquibase 14.15.0 发布, Source of truth for the Dirigible system schema (DIRIGIBLE_*) running in SystemDB.
        Liquibase JSON changelogs in src/main/resources/db/changelog/ create and version every
        platform table; Hibernate is reduced to schema validation (DIRIGIBLE_DATABASE_SYSTEM_DDL_AUTO
        defaults to "validate") and no longer issues DDL during application startup.
        Dynamic user entities (TypeScript @Entity via data-store, Java @Entity via
        data-store-java) continue to use Hibernate's hbm2ddl=update because their schema is
        authored by end-user code, not by changelogs.

        bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Metrics panel light-up: meters registered on the live composite
        MeterRegistry are read in process by the shared engine MetricsReportProvider, grouped and mapped onto

com.julien-dubois.bootui:bootui-quarkus-rest-client-integration-tests 1.13.0 发布, Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds quarkus-rest-client on top of the
        bootui-quarkus extension and proves the REST Client panel light-up: a @RegisterRestClient proxy is
        registered and called from a test, the BootUI QuarkusRestClientTraceListener SPI hook registers a
        QuarkusRestClientTraceFilter on the proxy, the filter feeds the shared RestClientTraceRecorder, and the
        panel is surfaced on GET /bootui/api/rest-client-trace with working clear and recording-toggle actions.
        Kept separate from bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO
        quarkus-rest-client, so the class-presence gate keeps the REST Client panel unavailable) so
        the present and absent paths are each proven in isolation — the same split used for the
        cache-present/absent and email-present/absent coverage. No Docker is needed; the @RegisterRestClient
        target is the test app's own loopback port.

com.julien-dubois.bootui:bootui-quarkus-hibernate-integration-tests 1.13.0 发布, Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds quarkus-hibernate-orm (on an in-memory H2 database) on
        top of the bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Hibernate (ORM mapping) advisor light-up end to end:
        the app's mapped @Entity classes are read from the EntityManagerFactory metamodel by the engine
        JpaMetamodelReader (via the capability-gated QuarkusEntityDiscovery), the shared engine HibernateScanner
        runs its curated rule registry on POST /bootui/api/hibernate/scan, and the QuarkusHibernatePropertyLookup
        maps the engine's config keys onto the quarkus.hibernate-orm.* namespace (proving, in particular, that the
        Spring-only Open-Session-in-View rule HIB-CONFIG-001 stays inert). Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO Hibernate ORM) so the ORM-absent
        not-configured path and the ORM-present scan path are each proven in isolation — the same split used for
        the SmallRye-Health and OpenTelemetry present/absent coverage.

        extension and proves the Email Viewer panel light-up: an outgoing message sent through the
        application's Mailer fires a io.quarkus.mailer.SentMail CDI event that the QuarkusEmailCapture observer
        maps into the shared engine EmailCaptureService, so the panel is surfaced on GET /bootui/api/email with
        working detail + .eml download reads and a DELETE clear action. Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO quarkus-mailer, so the class-presence gate
        keeps the email panel unavailable) so the mailer-present and mailer-absent paths are each proven in
        isolation — the same split used for the cache-present/absent coverage. The default test-mode mailer is
        mock (quarkus.mailer.mock defaults to true under LaunchMode.TEST), so no SMTP server or Docker is
        needed; the SentMail event still fires in mock mode.

com.julien-dubois.bootui:bootui-quarkus-prod-shell-guard-integration-tests 1.13.0 发布, Holds the one test in the whole bootui-quarkus-integration-tests reactor that boots a genuine
        LaunchMode.NORMAL (production) artifact via QuarkusProdModeTest, proving BootUiProdShellGuardFilter
        actually 404s /bootui and /bootui/** in a real production process (not just LaunchMode.TEST, which is
        all every @QuarkusTest elsewhere in this reactor can exercise). Kept in its own module/JVM fork on
        purpose: Quarkus's own test-framework ExclusivityChecker throws IllegalStateException if a
        QuarkusProdModeTest and a @QuarkusTest run in the same JUnit Platform launcher session (i.e. the same
        Surefire fork), so this test cannot live alongside base's (or any other submodule's) @QuarkusTest
        classes. Never published.

com.julien-dubois.bootui:bootui-quarkus-security-integration-tests 1.13.0 发布, Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds the quarkus-security extension on top of the
        bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Security Logs panel light-up: with quarkus.security.events.enabled
        the CDI security events fired on authentication/authorization are captured by QuarkusSecurityEventCapture
        into the shared SecurityEventBuffer, assembled by the neutral SecurityLogsService and surfaced on
        GET /bootui/api/security-logs, with the panel reported available in the manifest. Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which has NO security extension) so the security-absent unavailable path
        and the security-present capture path are each proven in isolation. Also adds quarkus-opentelemetry (like
        the sibling otel module) so a real server-span trace id is available at capture time, proving the Live
        Activity feed's security correlation: a captured security event nests under the REQUEST entry sharing its
        trace id and stamps that request's securedPrincipal.

com.julien-dubois.bootui:bootui-quarkus-integration-tests-aggregator 1.13.0 发布, Aggregator for the Docker-free Quarkus integration-test apps. Each sub-module pins a different
        extension set on its classpath to prove BootUI panel light-up in isolation: the base module deliberately
        has no optional extensions (everything fails closed), and each per-extension module adds a focused
        capability fixture. The RabbitMQ module drives synthetic SmallRye metadata with Dev Services disabled,
        so the default suite requires no broker or Docker. The Hibernate module also lives here but is wired into
        the reactor only on a Hibernate-capable JDK (see the root pom profile).
        prod-shell-guard is different in kind, not in extension set: it holds the one test that boots a genuine
        LaunchMode.NORMAL artifact via QuarkusProdModeTest, kept out of every other module because Quarkus
        refuses to mix that mechanism with @QuarkusTest in the same Surefire fork.
